title: Barbarossa Exhausted
subtitle: Phase V research brief · full historical study in preparation
author: R.G. Cruise

p5-cmh-moscow: Chapter III, To Moscow. Starting operational and strategic reference; verify each eventual narrative claim and military feature independently.
ushmm-pow-treatment: 1941–January 1942 discussion of German prisoner policies. Later aggregate mortality must not be assigned to one selected day.
p5-loc-atlas-candidate: Collection-level candidate only. No exact Phase V sheet or printed situation date verified in this increment.

summary: The concluding study will assess why Germany failed to achieve its invasion objectives, compare the three operational theatres and explain the transition to Soviet counteroffensive operations.

researchStatus: Research brief and article route established. Full narrative, claim-level citations and dated military reconstruction remain in preparation.
referenceMapStatus: Candidate atlas collection only. No exact sheet or daily situation date has been verified; an earlier or later sheet must not be relabelled.
chronologyNotes: 5 December is this atlas’s editorial endpoint, not a universally accepted formal termination date for Operation Barbarossa.
Account for verified Kalinin Front attacks on 5 December; the broader operations beginning on 6 December are context, not completed Phase V movements.
Tikhvin’s later recapture and the subsequent winter campaign must not be projected backward or opened as an empty new collection.
sourceMethod: Starting research references identify the planned evidence base. An outline is not a completed historical narrative or a verified tactical map.
